assistant|productivity_tip_pomodoro: Suggested using the Pomodoro Technique: work for 25 minutes, take a 5-minute break, repeat for 4-6 cycles
assistant|productivity_tip_calendar: Suggested creating a master calendar tracking assignments, deadlines, work shifts, and personal events with time blocks for studying and self-care
assistant|productivity_tip_task_chunking: Suggested breaking large assignments into smaller manageable tasks with allocated time slots
assistant|app_recommendation_todoist: Recommended Todoist: a task management app for to-do lists, reminders, and progress tracking (Free, Premium $3/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_trello: Recommended Trello: a visual project management tool using boards, lists, and cards (Free, Premium $12.50/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_evernote: Recommended Evernote: a note-taking app for notes, tasks, and projects across devices (Free, Premium $7.99/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_rescuetime: Recommended RescueTime: a time management tool tracking device usage and productivity insights (Free, Premium $9/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_google_task: Recommended Google Tasks: a simple task management app integrating with Google Calendar and Gmail (Free)
assistant|app_recommendation_any_do: Recommended Any.do: a task management app with to-do lists, reminders, and collaboration (Free, Premium $2.99/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_microsoft_t: Recommended Microsoft To Do: a task management app integrating with Microsoft Outlook (Free)
assistant|app_recommendation_forest: Recommended Forest: a productivity app gamifying focus with a forest growth model (Free, Premium $1.99/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_wunderlist: Recommended Wunderlist: a task management app with to-do lists, reminders, and collaboration (Free, Premium $4.99/month)
assistant|app_recommendation_clickup: Recommended ClickUp: an all-in-one project management tool with task management, time tracking, and collaboration (Free, Premium $5/month)
assistant|tool_comparison_todoist_trello: Advised that Todoist suits simple, list-based task management with task hierarchies, while Trello suits visual, board-based project management with collaboration features
assistant|great_ocean_road_facts: The Great Ocean Road is a 243-kilometer stretch of coastal road along Australia's southeastern coast with ocean, cliff, beach, and rainforest views
assistant|great_ocean_road_attraction: The Twelve Apostles limestone stacks are a famous highlight of the Great Ocean Road
Other Great Ocean Road attractions include London Bridge rock formation, Loch Ard Gorge, Apollo Bay, Otway National Park, and the Great Otway Fly Treetop Walk
assistant|great_ocean_road_travel_tip: Advised booking Great Ocean Road accommodations in advance, especially during peak season (December to February)
